const patch="*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Visual-feedback controller for the single RoboCasa tray-to-pot episode.
+
+Each invocation takes one reversible motion segment. Poses supplied on the command
+line are world-frame grip-site targets; the service expects robot-base targets.
+"""
+import argparse
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+ORIGIN = np.array([2.67, -2.17004, 0.91472])
+R_BASE_WORLD = np.array([[0., 1., 0.], [-1., 0., 0.], [0., 0., 1.]])
+OUT = Path('/app/output')
+
+
+def world_to_base(p):
+    return R_BASE_WORLD @ (np.asarray(p, dtype=float) - ORIGIN)
+
+
+def current_action(obs):
+    prop = dict(zip(obs.meta['proprio']['layout'], obs.meta['proprio']['now']))
+    layout = ['right_x','right_y','right_z','right_rx','right_ry','right_rz',
+              'left_x','left_y','left_z','left_rx','left_ry','left_rz',
+              'right_little','right_ring','right_middle','right_index',
+              'right_thumb_flexion','right_thumb_rotation',
+              'left_little','left_ring','left_middle','left_index',
+              'left_thumb_flexion','left_thumb_rotation']
+    return np.array([prop['cmd_'+x] for x in layout],dtype=float)
+
+
+def go(robot, side, world, steps, name, fingers=None, orientation=None, cameras=None):
+    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=['egoview'],video='none')
+    start = current_action(obs)
+    end = start.copy()
+    j = 0 if side == 'right' else 6
+    end[j:j+3] = world_to_base(world)
+    if orientation is not None:
+        end[j+3:j+6] = orientation
+    if fingers is not None:
+        k = 12 if side == 'right' else 18
+        end[k:k+6] = fingers
+    # Dense targets make the grip site track a gentle, known path.
+    arr = np.linspace(start,end,steps)
+    cams = cameras or ['egoview','robot0_eye_in_right_hand','robot0_agentview_right']
+    res = robot.submit('ee_pose',arr,cameras=cams,video='none',include_depth=True,note=name)
+    res.save(str(OUT/name))
+    p = dict(zip(res.meta['proprio']['layout'],res.meta['proprio']['now']))
+    print(json.dumps({'name':name,'time_left_s':res.meta['time_left_s'],
+                      'control_steps':res.meta['control_steps'],
+                      'done':res.meta['done'],'reason':res.meta['reason'],
+                      'right_eef': [p['eef_right_'+q] for q in 'xyz'],
+                      'left_eef': [p['eef_left_'+q] for q in 'xyz'],
+                      'right_fingers': [p['gripper0_right_R_'+q+'_pos'] for q in
+                                        ['index_proximal_joint','thumb_proximal_pitch_joint']]},indent=2))
+
+
+def main():
+    ap=argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    ap.add_argument('name')
+    ap.add_argument('--side',default='right')
+    ap.add_argument('--world',nargs=3,type=float,required=True)
+    ap.add_argument('--steps',type=int,default=40)
+    ap.add_argument('--fingers',nargs=6,type=float)
+    ap.add_argument('--orientation',nargs=3,type=float)
+    args=ap.parse_args()
+    go(Robot(),args.side,args.world,args.steps,args.name,args.fingers,args.orientation)
+
+
+if __name__=='__main__':
+    main()
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch))
